metadata.title: Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
metadata.subject: English

blocks.content: Welcome to 'Nelson Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom'! Let's test your understanding of this story with some hand-picked questions.
blocks.content_hi: इस कहानी के बारे में आपकी समझ का परीक्षण करें।
blocks.content_gu: આ વાર્તા વિશે તમારી સમજણની કસોટી કરો.

blocks.question_gu: प्रश्न १: 'लॉन्ग वाक टू फ्रीडम' ના लेखक કોણ છે?
blocks.explanation: Correct answer as per the DEO question bank.
blocks.explanation_hi: DEO प्रश्न बैंक के अनुसार सही उत्तर।
